capabilities.body: OpenAmer eteekateeka omulimu, n'egukola ng'ekozesa ebikozesebwa ebituufu — ekifo ky'ebiragiro, omutimbaganyi, fayiro, kodi — n'etereka ebyakola obulungi.
capabilities.title: Omuyambi alowooza naawe

capabilities.body: Emboozi, ebijjukirwa ne modeli bisigala ku kyuma kino. Tewali kiweerezebwa ku mutimbagano okuggyako ng'okisabye.
capabilities.title: Ebyuma byo, ebikwata ku ggwe

capabilities.body: Ennimi 186, buli lulimi mu nnukuta z'osoma. Olutimbe olusooka olukusaba okulonda olulimi.
capabilities.title: Olulimi lwo, mu ngeri entuufu

capabilities.body: Obukugu buterekebwa okuva mu mirimu egikoleddwa, emirimu egya bulijjo ne gyanguwa gy'okoma okugikozesa.
capabilities.title: Obusobozi obweyongera

help: Kebera nti ekyuma kino kisobola okuyungibwa ku yintaneeti.
Bwe kiremwa emirundi ebiri, ggulawo ebiwandiiko by'ebibaddewo; ennyiriri ezisembayo ziraga omutendera.
failure.lead: Tewali nkyukakyuka zizziddwa mabega mu kasirise — OpenAmer esigala we yakoma, bw'oddamu etandikira awo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ekyali ku nfulumya eyasooka era ekyakola. Tewali kyakyusiddwa kitundu kyokka.
failure.title: Okuteekateeka tekwawedde

language.lead: Okuteekateeka kweyongera mu lulimi lw'olonze wano. Osobola okulukyusa oluvannyuma mu pulogulaamu.
language.title: Londa olulimi lwo

progress.lead: Okuteekateeka okw'omulundi gumu: OpenAmer ewanula ebyetaagisa era eteekateeka ekyuma kino. Bw'ogitandika oluvannyuma, bino byonna tebiddaamu.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ekyusaamu enfulumya eyasooka. Entuula zo, ebijjukirwa n'enteekateeka tebituusibwako.
progress.title: Okuteekateeka OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Okulamba nti okuteeka ku kyuma kuwedde
stages.configure: Okuteekateeka ebisumuluzo bya API ne modeli
stages.dependencies: Okuteeka ebyetaagisa bya Python ku kyuma
stages.node-deps: Okuteeka ebyetaagisa bya Node.js ku kyuma
stages.platform-sdks: Okuteeka SDKs z'emikutu gy'obubaka ku kyuma
stages.system-packages: Okuteeka ripgrep ne ffmpeg ku kyuma
stages.uv: Okuteeka omuteesiteesi w'ebipakiti uv ku kyuma

cards.body: Ggulawo pulogulaamu era onnyonnyole ky'oyagala kikolebwe. OpenAmer ekolera emabega n'ekutegeeza ebivuddemu.
cards.title: Tandika n'emboozi emu

cards.body: Enteekateeka → Endabika → Olulimi. Enteekateeka z'ennimi n'ebitundu 186, osobola okukyusa essaawa yonna.
cards.title: Londa olulimi lwo

cards.body: Omulimu oguddibwamu gufuuka bukugu — omulundi oguddako gwetaaga ekiragiro kimu kyokka.
cards.title: Gireke ejjukire

success.command: oba gitandike oluvannyuma okuva mu kifo ky'ebiragiro:
success.lead: Byonna biri mu kifo kyabyo. OpenAmer kati yiyo — ku kyuma kino, mu lulimi lwo.
success.title: OpenAmer yeeteeseteese

bullets: Ekolera ku kyuma kino — emboozi zo zisigala wano
Byonna bisobola okukyusibwa oluvannyuma; tewali kya lubeerera
welcome.lead: Omuyambi wo. Ku byuma byo. Mu lulimi lwo.
welcome.leadUpdate: Enfulumya ya OpenAmer empya yeeteeseteese. Eno edda mu kifo ky'enfulumya eyasooka era ekuuma buli lutuula na buli nteekateeka.
welcome.note: Kitwala eddakiika ntono ku yintaneeti eya bulijjo.
welcome.title: Tukusanyukidde ku OpenAmer
